description: Class representing a single custom or built-in table style.

Delete.description:
Deletes the custom table style. Formatted tables and pivot tables that use it switch to the workbook default styles.
If the style is itself a workbook default, that default is reset to TableStyleMedium2 or PivotStyleLight16 first.

Duplicate.description: Creates a custom copy of the table style with all its formatting and gallery flags.

params.description: The name of the copy. Must be unique among the custom and built-in style names (case-insensitive).
params.name: name

GetBuiltIn.description: Returns whether the table style is a built-in style.

GetName.description: Returns the name of the table style.

GetShowAsAvailablePivotTableStyle.description: Returns whether the table style is shown in the pivot table style gallery.

GetShowAsAvailableTableStyle.description: Returns whether the table style is shown in the table style gallery.

GetTableStyleElements.description: Returns the collection of formatted parts of the table style, or a single part when its type is passed.

params.description: The table style element type to return instead of the whole collection.
params.name: type

SetShowAsAvailablePivotTableStyle.description: Sets whether the table style is shown in the pivot table style gallery.

params.description: Specifies whether the style is shown in the pivot table style gallery.
params.name: show

SetShowAsAvailableTableStyle.description: Sets whether the table style is shown in the table style gallery.

params.description: Specifies whether the style is shown in the table style gallery.
params.name: show
